description: Create a group inside a group category. This is addressed by group_category_id, not by course ID: find the category with list_group_categories. The new group has no members; add them with add_group_member.

group_category_id.description: The Canvas group category ID to create the group in (not a course ID)

join_level.description: Join policy for the group. Only affects self-joining in categories that allow multiple memberships (e.g. student-organized); for teacher-managed group sets, self-signup is a category setting.

name: create_group
title: Create Group
